audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 against a 73.91% win rate, and the page's own late text says 'you own this lane so hard it should already be over'.
audit.why: Quinn has no way to win a poke war against a 950-range Inner Flame with Gathering Fire refunds; her Vault is an escape, not an engage, and her only real edge is the level-6 roam.
audit.corrected: diffRating 3/10, carryRating 5/10, both difficulty lines reworded to favoured.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every row disagreed with its own why: the chart gave Quinn levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items while the whys say you out-tempo her, 'your bullying peak', 'out-poke her again and snowball' and 'you still out-poke and out-shield her into two items'. Level 6 was Skill while its why says 'Quinn's only real spike beats yours here'.
audit.why: This is a poke lane Karma wins at every stage except 6, where Behind Enemy Lines gives Quinn a roam-and-reset Karma cannot match. The packet levelChart says exactly that.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Quinn, Karma, Karma in matched pairs across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the blind to Vault (E) in six places, including the tracked-ability label 'Vault (Dash/Blind)'. Vault is a dash that damages, slows and briefly interrupts — it does not blind. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q), which hinders vision. 'Knock you back' is also wrong: Vault leaps Quinn off the target, it does not displace Karma. Her move speed was also called a 'nimble passive'; it comes from Heightened Senses after attacking a Harrier target.
audit.why: A player told the dash blinds will hold Inspire for the wrong cast and misread which cooldown gates her poke. Vault's real cooldown (12/11/10/9/8s) is the timer that matters, and Behind Enemy Lines is a channel Focused Resolve cancels outright — never stated anywhere.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, wants.foe[0], wants.foe[1] and wants.you[2] all corrected; dosFull[2].d now states the ult-channel cancel.

notes: Main error: the blind was attributed to Vault (E) throughout, including the tracked-ability label. Vault dashes, damages, slows and briefly interrupts; the blind is Blinding Assault (Q). 'Knock you back' is also wrong — Vault leaps Quinn away, it does not displace Karma. focus.text is the string 'Quinn Vault (Dash/Blind)' at 24 characters, which the applier skips as under 25, so that label cannot be corrected through a normal edit — it needs a manual fix or the applier's short-string rule relaxed. Unverified and left alone: the existing claim in whys[2]/mid/wants.you[1] that Focused Resolve roots her 'through the Vault dash' — whether a dash breaks the tether is not in the kit file.
